categories.name: Formation & Government
categories.rule: Use authoritative government/regulator sources. Never invent a filing, fee, deadline, portal or completion.

categories.name: Money
categories.rule: Critical arithmetic deterministic; external financial actions approval-gated.

categories.name: Customers & Sales
categories.rule: Respect provider terms, privacy, anti-spam rules and user authorization.

categories.name: Marketing
categories.rule: Publish/send only through a connected provider with required approval.

categories.name: Operations
categories.rule: Track outcome and evidence; do not mark complete from AI text alone.

categories.name: Professional Help
categories.rule: Escalate when professional judgment/authorization is required; do not impersonate professionals.

completion_rule: No route milestone advances from an execution action until required evidence is present and verified.
